text.arabic_uthmani: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا

baseline.text: Yedi gök, yer ve bunlarda bulunanlar O'nu yüceltir. O'nu överek yüceltmeyen hiçbir şey yoktur; fakat siz onların yüceltmesini anlamazsınız. O gerçekten yumuşak davranandır, çok bağışlayandır.

findings.text: Her varlığın kendi düzenli hareketi bağımlılığını ve övgüsünü fiilen gösterir; insanların bunu çözememesi yüceltmenin gerçekleşmediğini değil, algının sınırlı olduğunu anlatır.

activation_trace.role: The worship and praise branch supplies the repeated act distributed across every grammatical scale of the ayah.
The over-arching upper realm supplies the high pole of the ayah's total spatial span.
The lower realm opposed to heaven supplies the low pole, leaving no vertical zone outside the praise-order.
The unrestricted knowable and reportable entity closes the remaining categorical exceptions.
Praise opposed to blame gives the universal act its affirmative evaluative content.
Understanding language or meaning marks human reception as the failed stage, not creation's performance.

changed_reading.after: Every entity participates in an actual order of praise whose mode does not depend on human ability to decode it.
changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth are said generally to glorify God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threefold س ب ح sequence expands from the heavens and earth to their inhabitants and then to the exceptionless construction covering every thing, before distinguishing that activity from human comprehension.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated praise-action, an upper-to-lower cosmic span, an unrestricted entity term, and the praise complement form an all-inclusive liturgical order. The ف ق ه denial places the limit in the human interpreter rather than in the participation of creation.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming supply patterned motion as a possible embodied mode of the repeated praise.
Going, returning, and ranging through livelihood widen the kinetic image from a single stroke to ongoing circulation.
Elevation gives the moving field an upper trajectory.
The grounded lower pole keeps the model distributed through material as well as celestial domains.
Failure to comprehend permits a non-lexical mode without weakening the assertion that praise occurs.

changed_reading.after: The ordered movement and circulation of beings may itself be their enacted tasbih, intelligible as praise to God but not necessarily as speech to humans.
changed_reading.before: Tasbih is imagined primarily as an utterance made by cosmic subjects.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same س ب ح root governs the whole ayah, while the subjects range across elevated heavens, grounded earth, inhabitants, and every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The swimming, running, roaming, and oscillating branches activate a kinetic model: each entity's sustained course through its proper domain can function as its praise. This is a branch resonance rather than a claim that the intensive praise forms simply mean physical swimming.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and distancing from defect supply the negative pole of every entity's testimony.
Affirmative praise supplies the positive pole paired with exoneration.
The unrestricted entity term universalizes the two-pole testimony.

changed_reading.after: Every thing bears a two-sided witness: it disowns defect from God and positively manifests what is praiseworthy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Every scale of creation is made the subject of س ب ح, and its activity is joined to praise.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exoneration branch makes universal tasbih simultaneously negative and positive: creation clears God of defect while its ordered existence praises Him. The ayah is therefore testimony, not only devotion.

activation_trace.role: Failure to grasp the praise supplies the human deficit to which the closing predicates respond.
Deliberate restraint and control of anger supply suspended consequence rather than immediate rupture.
Covering the fault and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the protective answer to incomprehension.

changed_reading.after: Forbearance and forgiveness explain how human beings can remain inside a universally praising world while failing to understand it.
changed_reading.before: The final divine names are a general devotional close.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adversative denial of human comprehension is followed immediately by the predicates حليما and غفورا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ending governs the mismatch between universal praise and human unreadiness. Restraint holds back the consequence of failed understanding, while forgiveness covers the fault and protects its bearer from its full effect.

activation_trace.role: Focus exoneration anchors the model in every entity's clearing of God from defect.
Saying what is not or assigning it supplies the mechanism of fabricated divine kinship.
Immediate pre-focus exoneration turns the focus repetition into continuation and expansion of a rebuttal.
The repeated attribution branch keeps human claims as the proposition being repudiated.
Elevation supplies separation between God and the descriptions projected onto Him.

changed_reading.after: All creation continuously contradicts false divine attributions, making aberrant human speech the local exception inside a reality-wide testimony.
changed_reading.before: All creation praises God in a general devotional sense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence surrounds claims about divine offspring and other gods with repeated human saying, then answers with exoneration and elevation. When 17:44 transfers tasbih to all creation, the universal chorus becomes a counter-testimony against fabricated attribution: mis-speaking humans are contradicted by the reality they inhabit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false-attribution, exoneration, and elevation; I supply the arrow that creation's universal tasbih functions as counter-witness to human claims. A live alternative is that 17:44 merely broadens praise without assigning it a polemical speech-act.
structural_cues: 17:40-43 repeats human قول around offspring and plurality claims, then places a سبحان form immediately before the focus.
17:44 shifts from a divine exoneration formula to heavens, earth, inhabitants, and every thing as active subjects of tasbih.

activation_trace.role: Focus failure to grasp meaning is the interpretive bottleneck developed by the adjacent sequence.
Prevention of access supplies the outermost layer between disclosure and receiver.
Covering makes the intervening obstruction itself unavailable to ordinary inspection.
A preserving cover relocated over the heart supplies an inward layer of occlusion.
The exact understanding root repeats the focus deficit and binds the adjacent anatomy to it.
Auditory heaviness supplies a sensory impediment rather than a lack of signal.
Listening as understanding and compliance exposes the gap between acoustic intake and receptive uptake.

changed_reading.after: The praise may be continuously disclosed, while layered failures of access, attention, and understanding make the human listener experience it as silence.
changed_reading.before: Creation's praise is intrinsically hidden or unlike anything humans could hear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context materializes failed reception across successive layers: a barrier in the interval, coverings over hearts, weight in ears, repetition of failure to understand, and listening without compliant understanding. The focus does not describe an absent or necessarily silent praise; it locates silence in a blocked human reception chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered barriers and an exact repetition of the understanding root; I extend their reception model from the Qur'an in the adjacent ayat to creation's tasbih in the focus. The live alternative is that these barriers concern recitation alone and do not specify how cosmic praise is missed.
structural_cues: Immediately after the focus's comprehension denial, 17:45-47 distributes obstruction across interval, heart, ear, and listening.
17:46 repeats ف ق ه while the surrounding constructions name both inward and auditory impediments.

activation_trace.role: The unrestricted entity term anchors even resistant and fragmented matter inside the focus claim.
Universal praise supplies the present activity whose material durability the context tests.
Fragmentation and debris supply the apparent loss of coherent agency.
Rousing what lies still supplies reactivation after material collapse.
Solid stone supplies a deliberately resistant material case.
Iron hardness supplies the stronger image of material refusal.
Return after departure connects changed material states back to renewed agency.
The call supplies the initiating summons in a relational response mechanism.
Answering speech supplies the overt response released by the summons.
The repeated praise complement identifies the response with the focus's universal praise.

changed_reading.after: Thinghood carries a summons-response disposition: neither fragmentation nor hardness can erase the capacity that reappears as praise when creation is called.
changed_reading.before: Even nonhuman things praise in an unspecified mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context escalates the resurrection challenge from fragmented remains to stone, iron, and anything imagined harder, then answers with return, divine call, human response, and the focus's same praise complement. This activates tasbih as a creation-deep response capacity that persists through disintegration and material resistance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material disintegration, resistant substances, reanimation, call, answer, and praise; I supply the arrow that the future response discloses a praise-capacity already asserted of every thing in 17:44. A live alternative is that 17:52 describes only resurrected human speech and does not explain present nonhuman tasbih.
structural_cues: 17:49-51 stages a material escalation from remains to stone, iron, and a still harder imagined creation.
17:52 resolves the sequence as summons followed by response and repeats the focus's praise complement.

activation_trace.role: The worship branch anchors every subject's activity as directed service rather than autonomous sacred power.
The heavens include the apparent upper beings within, rather than above, the praising order.
The worshipped-deity category supplies the rival status that the mechanism tests.
Seeking converts the supposed rivals into dependent agents oriented beyond themselves.
A traversable path supplies the one-way route from subordinate beings toward the throne's possessor.
Possession and power of disposal, explicitly negated in context, remove autonomous efficacy from invoked beings.
Human invocation supplies the mistaken upward relation that the ayah reverses.
The invoked beings' own seeking repeats their dependent orientation.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the actual center toward which those beings move.
Nearness gives the seeking relation a directional goal without granting the seeker divine independence.

changed_reading.after: The chorus maps a single-centered dependency field: every high or low being is a worshipper and seeker within the order, never a competing destination.
changed_reading.before: A plurality of beings joins in praise directed to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus directs the whole cosmic field to one recipient. Context on both sides strips supposed divine rivals of autonomy: hypothetical gods seek a path toward the possessor of the throne, while invoked beings lack disposal of harm and themselves seek nearness to their Lord. Universal tasbih is therefore a directed dependency structure, not an undifferentiated sacred chorus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival-deity language, paths, denied possession, and seekers of nearness; I read these as the relational geometry of the focus's directed tasbih. A live alternative is that the invocation polemic and the praise claim remain parallel arguments rather than one mechanism.
structural_cues: The focus's singular recipient pronoun receives praise from plural cosmic domains and every thing.
17:42 and 17:56-57 independently turn supposed rivals into seekers who lack autonomous disposal.

activation_trace.role: The focus locates the failure at understanding, allowing perception and interpretation to come apart.
Increase supplies the paradox that additional disclosure can intensify rather than cure a response.
Recoil and distancing supply the receiver's negative motion away from what is presented.
A manifest mark supplies disclosure that is available to recognition.
Contradiction of truth supplies interpretive refusal despite the sign's presence.
Actual seeing makes the denial a failure beyond mere sensory absence.
Showing and making visible supply deliberate exposure of material that can still be mishandled.
Testing distinguishes what disclosure elicits from what disclosure objectively provides.
Boundary-crossing rebellion supplies the intensified wrong response to further warning.

changed_reading.after: Tasbih may stand openly in the forms and acts of things, while human interpretation converts disclosure into neutrality, denial, or even resistance.
changed_reading.before: Humans fail to understand tasbih because its signal is concealed or non-perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly separates disclosure from reception: varied presentation increases aversion, a manifest sign is denied, and shown material becomes a test that increases transgression. The focus's uncomprehended tasbih therefore need not be hidden; it can be perceptibly present yet classified, narrated, or valued wrongly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, denial, testing, and worsening response; I generalize that reception pattern to the cosmic tasbih asserted in the focus. A live alternative is that creation's praise is genuinely inaccessible to ordinary perception rather than visibly present and misread.
structural_cues: 17:41 and 17:60 share an increase construction in which more disclosure produces a more negative response.
17:59 joins sign language, visibility, and denial in one episode.
The focus itself asserts universal activity before marking comprehension, not manifestation, as deficient.

remaining_uncertainties: The swimming and roaming branches are form-distant activations and should not replace the intensive praise sense.
The future praise-response in 17:52 may disclose present universal responsiveness, or it may concern only resurrected human speech.
The barriers in 17:45-47 explicitly govern Qur'anic reception and may only analogically explain failure to grasp cosmic tasbih.
The sign sequence permits a visible-misreading model but does not rule out genuinely imperceptible modes of praise.
strongest_changes: The immediate attribution polemic turns universal tasbih into creation-wide counter-testimony against false speech about God.
The adjacent barrier-heart-ear-listening chain relocates apparent silence from creation to blocked human reception.
The debris-stone-iron sequence and the later call-response with praise activate a durable summons-response capacity within thinghood.
The rival-deity and invoked-being sequences make universal praise a single-centered dependency structure.
The visible-sign episodes show that noncomprehension can be active misreading rather than lack of disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The context supplies unusually tight echoes of the focus: exoneration immediately before it, the same understanding root immediately after it, and a later call-response using the same praise complement. Motion, material resistance, reception barriers, and visible signs therefore produce mechanisms rather than loose thematic parallels.

activation_trace.role: A cover that protects supplies a focus-side form of concealment whose function is preservation.
Restraint supplies time and withheld consequence while comprehension remains blocked.
A screening barrier supplies the contrasting cover that obstructs relation rather than preserving its subject.
Ordinary covering reinforces the material analogy across the boundary.
A cover over the inward faculty localizes the obstructive side of the analogy at reception.

changed_reading.after: The boundary stages two functions of covering: divine forgiveness protects the uncomprehending while adjacent covers obstruct comprehension, and forbearance holds open the interval between them.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a generic closure after the statement of incomprehension.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links distinct covering roots across the ayah boundary rather than treating them as synonyms. It remains anchored in the focus's غفورا and حليما and in the adjacent barrier vocabulary. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy contrasting protective with obstructive covering, not as a lexical derivation or a claim that every failure to understand is divinely imposed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus closes failed comprehension with forbearance and a forgiveness root whose material branch is protective covering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Every thing participates in ordered motion whose praise exceeds human decoding.** `س ب ح:B001/B004` joins worshipful praise with coursing, `ش ي ء:B001` the knowable thing, `ف ق ه:B001` grasping, and `ح ل م:B001` restraint. Universal repetition supplies praise; non-understanding blocks access, not occurrence. I infer each being's proper motion manifests dependence, while divine forbearance accommodates human perceptual failure. Tasbih reads as enacted creaturely order as well as voiced praise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:107–109 provides the surprising human exception to non-understanding: sequential recitation becomes witnessed bodily lowering, tears, and increased humility.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Praise as enacted cosmic coursing.** Lexical evidence: `س ب ح B004` (motion by swimming or coursing) in repeated `تُسَبِّحُ/يُسَبِّحُ/تَسْبِيحَهُمْ`, and `ف ق ه B001` (grasping and understanding a thing) in `تَفْقَهُونَ`. Structural cue: heavens, earth, occupants, and every thing are arranged as concentric participants; 17:41 varies recitation, 17:43 declares transcendence, and 17:45–46 immediately diagnoses blocked human reception. Assigned role: coursing lets each thing's ordered movement perform praise, while understanding is the human capacity that fails to decode it. Abductive move: vocal praise is not excluded, but I infer enacted alignment from the motion branch plus the total inclusion of nonhuman things. Reading change: tasbih becomes a cosmic mode of rightly ordered activity whose unintelligibility exposes a deficit in the listener, not silence in creation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:45–46 corrected any assumption that `لَا تَفْقَهُونَ` means creation is mute: the later partition and weighted ears locate the failure squarely in human reception.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form II glorification, with the action introduced before its delayed cosmic subjects
words.prose: {{ar:تُسَبِّحُ}} ({{tr:tusabbiḥu}}) opens by placing the act of glorification before the heavens, earth, and inhabitants are named, so the reader meets the action before the cosmic agents; the verb also has no direct object, while the following dative phrase supplies direction toward Him. Its feminine singular agreement fits the delayed plural subject, its Form II imperfect makes the praise ongoing and intensified, and the doubled sound compresses repeated praise into the form. The root image lets ordered cosmic movement color the act without replacing the local sense of glorification. The opening also resumes the prior transcendence claim from 17:43, participates in a same-surah s-b-h thread (17:1, 17:43, 17:93, 17:108), and begins the local root sequence that will move from named realms to every thing and then to a possessed verbal noun. Alternate readings sharpen the canonical agreement choice by changing tense, order, or masculine-feminine pressure, but they remain contrastive rather than controlling the local parse.
words.root_gloss_range: gliding or moving freely and declaring transcendence or praise; locally the praise/transcendence branch governs, while the motion image supplies secondary texture

topics.headline: opening action precedes cosmic subjects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first establishes glorification itself, then lets the cosmic subjects arrive as its carriers.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the verb the head of the first clause, with the heavens as delayed subject and the directional phrase attached to the verb.

topics.headline: Form II imperfect sustains repeated praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents glorification as continuing and intensified rather than as a single completed act.
topics.reason: The aligned form is a Form II imperfect, and the doubled consonant belongs to the local spelling and sound pattern.

topics.headline: motion image colors declared praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a background image of ordered movement, while the local verb still means glorification and transcendence.
topics.reason: The root family includes movement imagery, but the local Form II religious predicate and its complements select glorification as the active sense.

topics.headline: root sequence links transcendence to enacted praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine transcendence stated in 17:43 becomes enacted cosmic glorification in 17:44.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows point to the 17:43 boundary and the local repetition of the same root; the ayah itself repeats the root later in the verse.

topics.headline: variant readings sharpen agreement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that alternate readings can highlight the canonical agreement choice, while they do not govern the local parse.
topics.reason: The local QAC form is the feminine singular imperfect; variant reports are useful as contrast only.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus divine pronoun directing glorification toward Him
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) makes the opening glorification explicitly God-directed before the subjects are named. The compact preposition-pronoun unit keeps benefit, direction, and belonging close together, and its fronted position means the reader hears the divine referent before the heavens and earth appear.

topics.headline: praise is directed toward Him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic praise is not free-floating; it is directed to the divine referent from the start.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun governed by the preposition as complement of the opening verb.

topics.headline: fronted phrase precedes named subjects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine direction comes before the delayed cosmic subjects, setting the frame of the whole inventory.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase occurs immediately after the verb and before the nominative subject sequence.

words.gloss_range: the definite plural heavens as the first named delayed subject of glorification
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ}} ({{tr:al-samāwātu}}) are the first named subject after the verb, definite and plural, so the scene begins with the known elevated realms rather than with a vague sky. Their root pressure gives upperness to the first rung of the scope sequence, which then descends through earth, contained beings, and finally every thing. The familiar heaven-earth pairing is active, but the local word also carries the prior transcendence claim from 17:43 into the elevated created realm.
words.root_gloss_range: elevation, height, and upperness; locally the elevated realm sense is selected as the first cosmic subject

topics.headline: first named delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens do not initiate the sentence; they arrive as carriers of an already stated glorification.
